isolation: Every scenario creates its own plans, named with the suffix T5603, and asserts only on them. The task lists are shared with earlier runs, which left overdue tasks and one extra 'Order business cards' on the standard checklist, so the overdue-reminder scenarios assert on the change in count rather than a total. Setup (Given) and most When steps went through the API with the published test logins' tokens; reminders, navigation, role gating and the dashboard were read in the browser. The test logins have no display names, so 'Sam Torres' and the like appear as the login names.
